records.text: Owens cited Carl Bernstein as explicitly listing Scripps Media among publications working on behalf of the CIA.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Anyways, when it was revealed by journalist Carl Bernstein which publications were working on behalf of the CIA, Scripps Media was on the list. Then it was Howard Scripps and he named them explicitly. Didn't get into much detail about what they were doing, but these were one of the mockingbirds.
